gpu_memory_observations.limitations: Whole screen including compilation, caches and all five arms; not incremental serving-graph memory. Driver free-memory deltas on unified-memory host are not attribution.

memory.note: CPU container cgroup memory.peak observed after tests; no inference about graph or serving memory.

gpu_graph_and_suite_observations.note: Measured across before/after DFlashCudaGraphManager captures for shapes (5,1), (10,2), (20,4), (40,8), (80,16); in-place metadata refresh adds 0 bytes to the CUDA graph pool.

confidence_interval.method: 10000-draw paired bootstrap over 24 trials per boot; separate boot intervals, not a serving confidence interval

performance_verdict: Component gain established on both fresh boots. At 8 requests/8K, 218.154 -> 5.128 us and 225.644 -> 5.096 us. With ~775 us queued GPU work, only 2.940 us and 2.663 us exposed saving. No serving gain established.

historical_host_gap_bound.limits: Old traces, rank 0 only, not one window, not candidate-38 or a speedup forecast.

build_check.note: Full pinned inputs prepared and verified on Spaceport. First attempt lacked pip; separate build environment with pip 25.2 fixed the downloader. No candidate image was built and no new GPU or serving job ran.

repository_tests.note: Includes synthetic HTTP/benchmark fixtures, not serving or GPU performance measurements.

claim_classification.acceptance: A demonstrated correctness improvement with preserved performance is acceptable; a speedup is not mandatory for that route.
claim_classification.no_loss_evidence: Requires bounds excluding a meaningful regression; an interval merely including zero is inconclusive.

multi_step_loop_inspection.dspark_generate_draft: Both parallel backbone forward across all N draft query rows and sequential N-step Markov sampling (_sample_sequential) are already captured inside the single FULL query CUDA graph.
multi_step_loop_inspection.overlap_explanation: With 775.3 us of GPU work queued ahead on the same stream, the ~215 us of asynchronous CPU work in eager_full finishes ~557 us before the GPU finishes sleeping, hiding the CPU host saving and leaving only the 2.66-2.94 us GPU-side kernel launch delta.
multi_step_loop_inspection.remaining_pre_graph_ops: prepare_dflash_inputs feeds the separate num_target_tokens-keyed context KV graph (_context_preparer.run), and tilelang_inputs.padding_rows depends on the runtime unpadded live token count when num_reqs is padded to a captured graph descriptor.
